articles.title: Sensex Sheds 649 Points as Brent Touches $108 on New Middle East Flare-Ups
articles.excerpt: India's equity benchmarks tumbled in early Friday trade after Brent crude surged toward $108 a barrel on fresh fighting in the Red Sea and the Strait of Hormuz, wiping out Thursday's tentative recovery and sealing a fifth straight weekly loss.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai with a falling stock chart graphic and text reading Stock Market Open Report Today September 11 2026. The Sensex fell 649 points in early trade on Friday as Brent crude surged toward $108 a barrel on escalating Middle East tensions.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs with Indian equity exposure face a fifth weekly loss on Indian holdings, while a weaker rupee increases remittance value but raises India-trip and import costs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: EPF Withdrawal Rules: What EPFO's Simplified Advance Norms Mean for Your Savings
articles.excerpt: Thirteen withdrawal provisions are now three categories, claims settle in three days, and auto-settlement rises to Rs 5 lakh — but a quarter of your corpus must stay put.
articles.image_caption: An illustration of EPF services like balance details, claim status and passbook download alongside the EPFO building. EPFO has simplified its advance withdrawal norms, easing the process for members.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs holding EPF balances from earlier Indian employment fall under the same simplified rules — another reason to keep UAN-linked records current.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Adyen to Expand India Operations as Local Profits More Than Double
articles.excerpt: The Dutch payments processor is betting on India's digital payments growth and rising cross-border commerce, with local headcount up tenfold since 2023 and pre-tax income at €3.18 million.
articles.image_caption: The Adyen payments platform. The company plans to expand its India operations after local profits more than doubled.
articles.nri_angle: Adyen's expansion supports cross-border payments for Indian businesses going global and multinationals entering India, a corridor that matters to diaspora-linked commerce.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex Crashes 813 Points as $100 Oil and West Asia Tensions Rattle Markets
articles.excerpt: The benchmark fell for a third straight session to 74,764 as Brent crude topped $100 and IT stocks led a broad selloff; India VIX jumped over 6%.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building on Dalal Street in Mumbai. The BSE Sensex crashed 813 points on Wednesday as crude oil topped $100 a barrel amid escalating West Asia tensions.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs with India equity exposure face a triple hit: falling stock prices, a weakening rupee and $100 crude squeezing corporate margins.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Rupee Slumps to 95.08 as Crude Tops $100 on US-Iran Escalation
articles.excerpt: The currency fell 34 paise in a single session as Brent crude breached $100 for the first time in six weeks; analysts see a negative bias ahead.
articles.image_caption: A large rupee symbol installation set against a living green wall. The Indian currency slumped 34 paise to close at 95.08 against the US dollar on Wednesday as crude oil breached $100 a barrel.
articles.nri_angle: A weaker rupee means remittances buy more back home, but it also fuels the inflation that erodes real returns on NRI deposits and India portfolios.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Adani Eyes Overseas Airports, Joins Catania Bidders as $1 Billion Fundraise Closes
articles.excerpt: The Financial Times reports the Adani Group is planning an international airports push; Reuters has reported the group is among the bidders for Sicily's Catania airport, as a $1 billion fundraise values Adani Airport Holdings at $18 billion.
articles.image_caption: Adani Group chairman Gautam Adani. Adani Airports is bidding for overseas airports as it builds a $1 billion fund.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora investors and travellers, a global Adani airports network would put an Indian operator on the flight paths many NRIs travel.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex Plunges 813 Points to Three-Month Low as Brent Crude Surges Past $100
articles.excerpt: Indian benchmarks fell for a third consecutive session as escalating US-Iran hostilities pushed oil prices above $100 a barrel, triggering broad-based selling across sectors.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building on Dalal Street in Mumbai. The Sensex plunged 813 points to a three-month low as Brent crude surged past $100 a barrel.
articles.nri_angle: Elevated crude prices and a weakening rupee directly affect NRI remittance values and the purchasing power of Indian-origin investors holding domestic equities.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: NSE IPO Expected to Price at ₹1,700–1,785 Per Share in One of India's Biggest-Ever Listings
articles.excerpt: The National Stock Exchange's long-awaited initial public offering could value the world's most active derivatives exchange at up to $46.4 billion, with listing expected the week of September 21.
articles.image_caption: The National Stock Exchange of India building in Mumbai's Bandra Kurla Complex. The NSE IPO is expected to price at ₹1,700–1,785 per share in what would be one of India's biggest-ever listings.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with unlisted market exposure to NSE stand to gain from the formal listing, while the IPO opens a new avenue for diaspora participation in India's capital market infrastructure.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Adani Airports Raises $1 Billion From Temasek, BlackRock and Premji Invest at $18 Billion Valuation
articles.excerpt: India's largest airport operator sold a 5.54% stake to a global investor consortium, valuing the business at nearly twice rival GMR Airports and more than Heathrow.
articles.image_caption: Adani Group chairman Gautam Adani. Adani Airports has raised $1 billion from Temasek, BlackRock and Premji Invest, valuing the airports business at $18 billion.
articles.nri_angle: Global investors including NRI-linked Premji Invest are backing India's airport expansion, which directly impacts connectivity and travel infrastructure for the diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Crude Oil Import Price Crosses $100 as Middle East Conflict Squeezes Supply Lines
articles.excerpt: The Indian Basket benchmark hit $101.07 per barrel on Friday, its highest since May, as US-Iran hostilities disrupt Gulf shipping and freight rates soar over 400%.
articles.image_caption: An oil refinery in India. Crude oil import prices have crossed $100 per barrel as escalating conflict in the Middle East squeezes global supply lines.
articles.nri_angle: Rising oil prices threaten higher fuel and food costs for Indian consumers, while a weaker rupee could increase the cost of remittances for the diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's 7.8% GDP Growth Faces Scrutiny Over Methods and Meaning
articles.excerpt: A former finance secretary, an ex-RBI governor, and a business strategist all question what India's headline growth number captures — and what it leaves out.
articles.image_caption: YouTube / India Global Review
articles.nri_angle: India's GDP methodology debate carries investment and portfolio implications for diaspora investors tracking the $4 trillion economy.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Axis Bank Revises NRI Fixed Deposit Rates: How FD Plus Compares to Standard FDs
articles.excerpt: The bank non-withdrawable FD Plus product offers up to 7.10% for NRE deposits, but the liquidity trade-off matters for diaspora investors weighing their options.
articles.image_caption: An Axis Bank branch. The bank has revised its NRI fixed deposit rates, including a new FD Plus product offering higher returns.
articles.nri_angle: NRI depositors face a choice between liquidity and yield as Axis Bank widens the gap between standard FDs and its no-withdrawal FD Plus product.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Markets Hit Six-Week Low as Oil Fears and Rate Hike Worries Drag Sensex Down 353 Points
articles.excerpt: The Sensex fell 0.46% to 76,163 with 14 of 16 sectors in the red, as Middle East tensions pushed Brent crude to $96.8 and strong U.S. jobs data reinforced Fed rate hike expectations.
articles.image_caption: Indian market summary showing a broad selloff on Monday. The Sensex fell 353 points to a six-week low as oil price fears and U.S. rate hike worries weighed on sentiment.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with Indian market exposure face near-term headwinds from crude oil inflation, Fed policy uncertainty, and weakening FII flows.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian IT Stocks Slide Up to 3% as Strong US Jobs Data Revives Fed Rate Hike Fears
articles.excerpt: Nifty IT index drops 2.3% to near three-year lows as robust US employment figures and Middle East oil tensions rattle markets.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai. Indian IT stocks fell up to 3 percent after strong US jobs data revived fears of further Federal Reserve rate hikes.
articles.nri_angle: Indian IT is one of the most widely held sectors in NRI portfolios; the Fed rate decision and AI transition will shape near-term and long-term returns.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: CBI Files Chargesheet Against 17 in Rs 9,280-Crore Reliance ADA Fraud Case
articles.excerpt: Three senior executives, eight group companies, and six bank officials named in supplementary chargesheet as India's largest corporate fraud probe widens.
articles.nri_angle: The fraud case involved LIC and EPFO funds, directly affecting diaspora members with NRI deposits and Indian market investments.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Motilal Oswal AMC Crosses ₹2 Lakh Crore in Assets as Foreign Investors Return to India
articles.excerpt: The asset manager hit the milestone in August, powered by 23 new fund launches in FY2026 and record SIP inflows of ₹16,479 crore — while its group CEO says foreign capital is flowing back.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building on Dalal Street in Mumbai. Motilal Oswal AMC has crossed two lakh crore rupees in assets under management as foreign investors return to Indian markets.
articles.nri_angle: Indian diaspora investors watching the FII reversal may find renewed confidence in domestic equity allocations as trade deals and currency stability reshape India's risk profile.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Diaspora Deposits Record $127 Billion Under RBI Scheme, Exceeding All Estimates
articles.excerpt: The RBI's special FCNR window drew five times the inflows of its 2013 predecessor, pushing forex reserves to a record $729 billion and lifting the rupee to a two-month high.
articles.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India headquarters in Mumbai. India's diaspora deposits under the RBI's NRI deposit scheme have reached a record $127 billion.
articles.nri_angle: The $127 billion FCNR scheme offered NRIs interest rates up to 7.75% on dollar deposits with RBI-backed hedging, underscoring the diaspora's growing role as India's financial backstop.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Zerodha Enters Investment Banking After SEBI Grants Merchant Banking Licence
articles.excerpt: India's largest discount broker will focus on equity IPOs for new-age businesses through its newly approved subsidiary, Zerodha Corporate Advisors.
articles.image_caption: Nithin Kamath, founder and CEO of Zerodha, which has received SEBI approval to enter investment banking through a new merchant banking licence.
articles.nri_angle: Indian diaspora investors who trade through Zerodha may see expanded IPO access as the platform moves into investment banking.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RBI Faces Up to $12.7 Billion Bill From Record FCNR Deposit Scheme, Economists Warn
articles.excerpt: The central bank's decision to absorb hedging costs on $136 billion in foreign inflows could squeeze its dividend to the government over the next five years.
articles.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India faces up to $12.7 billion in hedging costs from record FCNR deposit inflows.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs who deposited in the FCNR scheme benefited from attractive returns with full repatriation, but the RBI's hedging costs raise questions about the long-term fiscal trade-off.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: CLARITY Act Explained: What the US Crypto Bill Means for Indian Investors
articles.excerpt: The landmark digital asset legislation heads to a Senate floor vote on September 15, establishing a regulatory framework that could reshape how Indian investors approach cryptocurrency markets.
articles.image_caption: The CLARITY Act faces a Senate cloture vote on September 15 as lawmakers work to establish US cryptocurrency regulation.
articles.nri_angle: Indian investors in US crypto markets stand to benefit from clearer asset classification and compliance rules, while India's own regulatory approach — built on a 30% flat tax and mandatory AML registration — differs fundamentally from the US framework.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex Gains 362 Points as Fed's Waller Signals Pause, but Weekly Losses Mount
articles.excerpt: Indian benchmarks snap a four-session losing streak after Fed Governor Christopher Waller's dovish comments, though crude oil concerns and Middle East tensions cap gains.
articles.image_caption: The BSE Sensex closed 362 points higher on September 4, snapping a four-session losing streak after Fed Governor Waller signaled a rate pause.
articles.nri_angle: Fed rate decisions directly affect NRI investment flows and remittance values; FCNR deposit surge shows diaspora capital playing a growing role in India's forex stability.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Returns to 'A' Category After 35 Years as Japan's JCR Upgrades Sovereign Rating
articles.excerpt: The Japan Credit Rating Agency raised India's long-term issuer rating from BBB+ to A-, citing 7.7% GDP growth, banking sector health, and structural reforms.
articles.image_caption: A credit rating dial showing investment-grade tiers. Japan Credit Rating Agency upgraded India to A- from BBB+, the highest sovereign rating India holds from any agency.
articles.nri_angle: The A- rating from Japan's JCR may boost confidence among Japanese and global institutional investors in India, potentially benefiting NRI portfolios and India-focused funds.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: BSE Gains as CEO Says NSE Cannot List on Own Platform, Setting Up India's Biggest IPO Battle
articles.excerpt: BSE CEO Sundararaman Ramamurthy's declaration that NSE must list on a rival exchange positions BSE as the sole venue for what could be India's largest-ever IPO.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai. BSE shares surged after NSE's CEO confirmed the rival exchange cannot list on its own platform, setting up a battle over India's biggest IPO.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors tracking the NSE IPO — expected to be one of India's largest — should note that trading will initially be on BSE, with regulatory uncertainty around whether NSE shares can eventually trade on NSE's own platform.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex Put Options Spike 500% as Closing Auction Triggers Another 2,100-Point Swing
articles.excerpt: India's new closing auction session caused the Sensex to briefly plunge 2,100 points on expiry day, sending put option premiums surging and reigniting calls for SEBI to intervene.
articles.image_caption: A SEBI office building in Mumbai. The regulator introduced the closing auction session on August 3 to determine official closing prices for F&O-eligible stocks.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with exposure to Indian equities or F&O markets face heightened expiry-day risk from CAS volatility, making position management around auction windows critical.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gold Jumps 2% as Fed's Waller Cools Rate Hike Expectations
articles.excerpt: Spot gold surged past $4,470 an ounce after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller signaled openness to holding rates steady, pulling the dollar to a one-week low.
articles.image_caption: Gold bars in a smelting furnace. Spot gold rose 2 percent to its highest level since August 28 after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller signaled support for a rate cut at the September meeting.
articles.nri_angle: Gold price swings affect NRI investment portfolios and remittance calculations tied to dollar-rupee exchange rates.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Uber Cuts 3,300 Jobs in Largest Layoffs Since COVID-Era Downturn
articles.excerpt: The ride-hailing giant is slashing 10% of its workforce to flatten management layers and redirect investment toward robotaxis and autonomous vehicle technology.
articles.image_caption: The Uber Technologies headquarters in San Francisco. The ride-hailing company announced layoffs affecting 3,300 employees in its largest workforce reduction since the COVID-era downturn.
articles.nri_angle: The layoffs add to the 123,000-plus tech job cuts in 2026, heightening employment uncertainty for Indian-origin tech workers, many of whom face additional visa-related constraints when displaced.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US Private Sector Adds Just 38,000 Jobs in August, Missing Forecasts
articles.excerpt: ADP report shows the slowest pace of private-sector hiring since January, with manufacturing and professional services shedding jobs even as education and health care expanded.
articles.image_caption: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics headquarters in Washington, D.C. ADP reported that private-sector employers added just 38,000 jobs in August, well below forecasts.
articles.nri_angle: Immigration policy changes, including deportations and cancelled work authorizations, are among the factors dragging on U.S. job growth — a direct concern for the Indian diaspora community navigating work visa uncertainties.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wall Street Edges Higher as Investors Eye Deals Amid Bond Turmoil
articles.excerpt: All three major indexes gained ground Wednesday in a partial rebound from a three-day losing streak, though rising Treasury yields and Middle East tensions continue to cloud the outlook.
articles.image_caption: The New York Stock Exchange on Wall Street. US stocks edged higher as investors assessed deal activity amid ongoing bond market volatility.
articles.nri_angle: Rising Treasury yields are driving up mortgage rates — now near 6.7% — affecting homebuying costs for Indian-American families, while the volatile macro environment impacts investment portfolios.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sugar Stocks Soar Up to 59% on Dalal Street, but Analysts Warn Valuations Are Running Ahead
articles.excerpt: Rising domestic prices, tight global supplies and El Niño fears have sent sugar counters surging, yet experts say the market has already priced in two strong quarters.
articles.image_caption: White sugar and a spoon. Sugar stocks rallied up to 59% in August as domestic prices hit record levels amid supply concerns and a global deficit.
articles.nri_angle: Indian investors with exposure to BSE-listed sugar stocks face a classic cyclical trade amplified by ethanol policy — strength justified but extrapolation risky.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Citigroup and Axis Bank Partner to Finance NRI Foreign-Currency Deposits
articles.excerpt: The cross-border arrangement allows NRIs to leverage FCNR deposits as the RBI's concessional scheme attracts over $65 billion in just 11 weeks.
articles.nri_angle: The partnership gives NRIs a new way to earn returns on dollar savings through leveraged FCNR deposits with Axis Bank, backed by Citigroup's offshore financing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RBI Deposit Drive Attracts $73 Billion in NRI Inflows in Just 11 Weeks
articles.excerpt: India's central bank closed its special FCNR(B) swap window a month early after foreign currency deposits surpassed all expectations.
articles.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India headquarters in Mumbai. The RBI's deposit drive has attracted $73 billion in NRI inflows over 11 weeks.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs directly benefited from the scheme's elevated interest rates on foreign-currency deposits without rupee exposure risk.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: MBA Graduates Now Earn 52% More Than Engineers in India, and the Gap Is Widening
articles.excerpt: Deloitte India's Campus Workforce Trends 2026 report shows management roles commanding a growing salary premium over engineering positions, with the gap projected to hit 59% next year.
articles.image_caption: A view of Ahmedabad, home to IIM Ahmedabad, one of India's premier business schools. A 2026 Deloitte survey found MBA graduates in India now earn 52% more than engineering graduates.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian-origin professionals weighing an MBA, the data shows a widening salary premium for management talent in India's corporate market, driven by demand for technology-meets-business skills.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Economy Grows 7.8% in April-June, Beating All Forecasts
articles.excerpt: GDP growth in Q1 FY2027 comfortably surpassed the 7.1% consensus and the RBI's 7% projection, driven by a surge in manufacturing and investment activity.
articles.nri_angle: India's strong growth run — potentially the fourth consecutive year above 7% — could support equity markets and attract portfolio inflows, with implications for NRI investors.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tata Motors EV Bookings Triple as Company Bets on Record Festive Quarter
articles.excerpt: India's largest EV maker has seen a three-fold surge in electric vehicle bookings over six months but faces supply constraints as it targets the industry's biggest-ever September-December quarter.
articles.image_caption: Tata Nexon EV, India's best-selling electric vehicle. The company reported a threefold jump in EV bookings ahead of the festive quarter.
articles.nri_angle: Tata Motors' EV push reflects India's rapid shift toward electric mobility, a transformation closely watched by diaspora investors and NRIs considering vehicle purchases during visits home.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Passes Bill to Reintroduce Fees on UPI Merchant Payments
articles.excerpt: After six years of zero charges that fueled the world's largest real-time payment system, New Delhi will allow banks to levy merchant fees on large UPI transactions while keeping person-to-person payments free.
articles.image_caption: India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI). The government passed a bill amending the Payment and Settlement Systems Act to allow merchant fees on UPI and RuPay debit card transactions.
articles.nri_angle: UPI operates in 11 countries and increasingly serves as a remittance channel for the Indian diaspora, making the fee structure directly relevant to NRI payments.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Stock Futures Slide as U.S. Strikes on Iran Rattle Global Markets
articles.excerpt: Oil prices surge past $90 a barrel and Asian equities tumble after U.S. forces hit Iranian launchers on Larak Island, reigniting fears of a wider Middle East escalation.
articles.image_caption: The Strait of Hormuz, where U.S. forces struck Iranian launchers on Larak Island. The military escalation sent global stock futures sliding and crude oil prices surging.
articles.nri_angle: Rising oil prices and potential Fed rate hikes could increase inflationary pressure on U.S. households, including the Indian diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Meets Fiscal Deficit Target for FY26 as Credit Ratings Improve, Sitharaman Says
articles.excerpt: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman told the Indian diaspora in Chicago that India achieved its fiscal deficit goal of 4.4% of GDP for 2025-26 and is targeting a debt-to-GDP ratio of 50% by 2030.
articles.image_caption: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addresses the Indian diaspora in Chicago during her nine-day official visit to Canada and the United States. She confirmed India met its fiscal deficit target of 4.4% of GDP for FY26.
articles.nri_angle: Finance Minister Sitharaman delivered the fiscal update while addressing the Indian diaspora community in Chicago during a nine-day US-Canada visit.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Economy on Track for 7% Growth in FY27 Despite Global Headwinds, EY Says
articles.excerpt: A recent EY report projects India's real GDP growth at 7-7.2% in FY27, supported by robust industrial output, a government capex rebound, and strong credit growth, even as inflation and weaker trade conditions pose risks.
articles.image_caption: India's economy is on track for 7% real GDP growth in FY27, according to EY, driven by industrial expansion, rising private investment, and strong domestic consumption.
articles.nri_angle: India's projected 7% growth in FY27 reinforces the investment case for NRIs and diaspora businesses with exposure to the Indian market.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: HDFC Bank Weighs Deputy MD Bharucha and External Candidate for CEO Succession
articles.excerpt: India's largest private lender is fast-tracking its leadership search after CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan announced he will not seek reappointment when his term ends in October.
articles.image_caption: HDFC Bank, India's largest private-sector lender. The bank is weighing Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha and an external candidate for CEO succession.
articles.nri_angle: HDFC Bank's leadership transition matters directly to NRI investors and depositors who hold significant stakes in India's largest private lender.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ex-MP Somaiya Seeks Probe Into Sensex's Wild 2,200-Point Swing
articles.excerpt: Former BJP MP Kirit Somaiya demands SEBI suspend its new Closing Auction Session mechanism after a five-minute crash and recovery on August 27.
articles.image_caption: Former BJP MP Kirit Somaiya. He has written to SEBI demanding a temporary suspension of the Closing Auction Session mechanism after the Sensex crashed over 2,200 points on August 27.
articles.nri_angle: Relevant for Indian diaspora investors with exposure to Indian equities through direct holdings or mutual funds. Market structure changes at NSE/BSE directly affect portfolio valuations.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: HDFC Bank CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan to Step Down After Three Decades
articles.excerpt: India's largest private lender fast-tracks succession search as Jagdishan declines reappointment, ending a turbulent chapter marked by boardroom friction and a 27% share price decline.
articles.image_caption: HDFC Bank, India's largest private-sector lender. CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan is stepping down after three decades with the bank, marking a major leadership transition.
articles.nri_angle: HDFC Bank is one of the most widely used banks for NRI accounts, remittances, and cross-border services. Leadership instability and the 27% share decline directly affect diaspora banking and investment.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
